crossRefs.note: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is…
Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear, and healed him.
translations.bsb: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.
translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
translations.asv: But Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye them thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
